description:
What is This Part?
This is the Transmission Clutch Cable for the Suzuki Samurai that runs from the Shifter Arm located on the Transmission to the Clutch Pedal.
Comes With Pin, Nut & Spring Kit For RHD (Right Hand Drive) Samurai Models
Has All Plastic Mounting Plate
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Clutch Cable – (for RHD Models Only) (59″)
Qty 1 – Pin, Nut & Spring Kit
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985-1995 (RHD Models Only)
Suzuki SJ413 1985-1995 (RHD Models Only)
Suzuki SJ410 1980-1984 (RHD Models Only)
